title: Library preparation from amplicon pool
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdm7i49n

steps.title: Prepare End Repair Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the following reaction for each sample in a tube:

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL DNA amplicons (5ng/ul)
Add 2.5 µL Nuclease-free water
Add 1.75 µL Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer
Add 0.75 µL Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix (Total volume: 15 µL)

steps.title: Incubate End Repair Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the following incubation sequence for the end repair reaction:

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00
Incubate at 65 °C for 00:05:00
Incubate on ice for 00:01:00

steps.title: Quantify Barcoded Amplicon Pools
steps.instruction: Quantify the barcoded amplicon pools using the Quantus Fluorometer with the ONE dsDNA assay.

steps.title: Set Up AMII Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Set up the adapter ligation reaction with the following components:

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µL End-repaired amplicon pools
Add 10 µL Ligation Buffer (LNB)
Add 5 µL Adapter Mix (AMX)
Add 5 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase (Total volume: 50 µL)

steps.title: Incubate Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the ligation reaction at room temperature for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Perform First SPRI Bead Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the library to SPRI beads:

substeps.instruction: Vortex SPRI beads thoroughly before use to ensure a homogenous brown colour
Add 50 µL (1:1) of SPRI beads to the sample tube and mix gently by flicking or pipetting
Pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature
Place on magnetic rack and incubate for 00:02:00 or until beads have pelleted and supernatant is clear
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant without touching the bead pellet

steps.title: Perform First SFB Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the beads using SFB (do not use 70% ethanol):

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL SFB and resuspend beads completely by pipette mixing
Pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube
Remove and discard the supernatant

steps.title: Perform Second SFB Wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the SFB wash process a second time:

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL SFB and resuspend beads completely by pipette mixing
Pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube
Remove and discard the supernatant

steps.title: Remove Residual SFB
steps.instruction: Pulse centrifuge and remove any residual SFB (air drying is not required for SFB washes).

steps.title: Elute Final Library
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the beads:

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µL EB and resuspend beads by pipette mixing
Incubate at room temperature for 00:02:00
Place on magnetic rack
Transfer final library to a new 1.5mL Eppendorf tube
